investigation_notes.Description: Anomalously large amount (535 Bytes) of high-entropy DNS traffic was observed from wkst-mktg-prod-04 to 184.28.193.72, involving domain tiktokcdn.com with random-looking subdomains. The root domain tiktokcdn.com is a long-established CDN (registered 2017-09-20), suggesting this could be legitimate traffic on the surface, but the presence of high-entropy subdomains and elevated payload size raises concern for DNS-based data exfiltration. Historical DNS activity shows multiple lookups to the root domain and related hosts, strengthening the possibility of covert DNS channel use; due to potential risk, this alert is treated as high priority for further investigation.
